## <custom data-type="emoji" data-id="id-1">:clipboard:</custom> Requirements

### Pricing Cards 

* As a potential customer I want to see pricing plans displayed in a clear card layout so that I can easily compare different subscription tiers
* Acceptance Criteria:

    * Display at least 3 pricing tiers (Basic, Premium, Enterprise)
    * Show price, billing period, and key features for each plan
    * Integrate variant switch between monthly and annually payment
    
        * display strikethrough prices
        
    * Include CTA button for each plan
    
* Storybook-stories have been created

    * Basic Plan
    * Premium Plan
    * Enterprise Plan (with disccounted price)

## **Technical Definition Acceptance :** 

### 📂 Component : `Molecule/Pricing/PricingCard.vue`

### Description : 

A pricing card component that displays a **Plan's title**, **price**, **features**, and **CTA**. It supports **strike-through pricing**, **unlimited seats**, and **localized money formatting**.  

| **Prop** | **Default** | **Type** |
| --- | --- | --- |
| title | - | `string`  
Name of the plan that is being displayed on top |
| price | - | `Money` |
| strikethroughPrice | - | `Money | undefined`  
If given, render this price before the actual price with a strikethrough-effect. ![](blob:https://media.staging.atl-paas.net/?type=file&localId=null&id=e5cd3077-c6d3-4848-beb3-5f95a0a959e0&&collection=&height=48&occurrenceKey=null&width=228&__contextId=null&__displayType=null&__external=false&__fileMimeType=null&__fileName=null&__fileSize=null&__mediaTraceId=null&url=null) |
| description | - | `string` |
| includedSeats | - | `number | 'unlimited'` |
| pricePerAdditionalSeat | - | `Money | undefined` |
| includedFeatures | - | `string[]`  
List of features that are include in the plan |
| excludedFeatures | - | `string[]`  
List of features not included in the plan. Rendered below `includedFeatures` |
| ctaText | - | `string`   
The title of the button |
| ctaLink  | - | `string`  
The page the button links to. Button is disabled if no link is provided. |
| period  | `'month'` | `string `   
The **billing period** (e.g., /month). |

* **Feature lists** → Rendered using `LuiIconList` for a consistent visual layout.
* **Prices** → Displayed using `I18nMoney` to ensure proper localization.
* **Strikethrough price** → Appears before the main price if provided, styled accordingly.
* **CTA button** → Navigates to `ctaLink` when clicked. 

##   
Technical Considerations:

**If** `ctaLink` is **empty  → The CTA Button shouldn't be displayed.**

longDescription:
## Purpose

The PricingCard component enables potential customers to quickly understand and compare subscription plan options through a clear, visually structured card layout. It presents pricing information transparently to help users make informed purchasing decisions.

## Use Cases

- Display individual subscription tiers (Basic, Premium, Enterprise) with their respective pricing and features
- Show discounted annual pricing alongside regular monthly rates using strikethrough formatting
- Present included features with checkmarks and excluded features with visual indicators
- Provide clear call-to-action buttons for plan selection or subscription initiation

## Design Rationale

Well-structured pricing information helps users decide on a plan more confidently. The component supports transparent pricing presentation without hidden costs, which strengthens customer confidence. Strikethrough pricing visually communicates savings for annual billing, encouraging longer-term commitments.
